dialogues.speaker: "What if We Do It This Way?"
dialogues.text: (This seems to be a reference book intended to impart practical techniques.)

dialogues.speaker: "What if We Do It This Way?"
dialogues.text: (The book lists a great number of issues that Fontainians are quite unlikely to encounter in their daily lives, and provides rigorously logical solutions to said problems.)

dialogues.speaker: "What if We Do It This Way?"
dialogues.text: (However, both the title page and the ending contain requests from the author for readers to not do such things in practice.)
